_meta: Cases excluded from their representability population because the LABELED vulnerability's upstream patch is measurably still exploitable (not merely a different, unrelated bug co-existing in the file) -- decided 2026-10-07 per the second audit-feedback round, Priority 2. The 'patched' sample for these cases cannot serve as a verified-safe negative without this caveat. Applied consistently: a case is excluded here only if the evidence shows the SAME labeled vulnerability mechanism remains triggerable in the patched/upstream-fixed code, not merely a different bug, an incomplete fix elsewhere in the file, or uncertainty about the VULNERABLE sample's own exploitability (a different axis, not covered by this exclusion).
